main.description: Walk commit ancestry from a ref or commit. Returns linearized history (first-parent by default) or full DAG.

startRef.description: Ref name to start from. Mutually exclusive with startCommit.

startCommit.description: Commit hash to start from. Mutually exclusive with startRef.

mode.description: firstParent = linearize via parent[0]; fullDag = topological order including merges.

pathFilter.description: Only include commits whose tree diff touches this path prefix.

authorDid.description: Only include commits authored by this DID.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor (commitHash of last returned entry).

errors.name: InvalidParameters
errors.description: Neither startRef nor startCommit given, or both.
